review:
Mahjong Wins Super Scatter is a 5×5 mahjong-tile slot with up to 2,000 ways to win and one of the highest ceilings in Pragmatic's catalogue: Super Scatters can lead to wins of up to 100,000x. In the base game, a win multiplier rises with consecutive tumbles, up to 5x.

Paying symbols on reels two to four can randomly be marked gold; a gold tile in a win leaves a wild behind for the next tumble. Three scatters give 10 free spins, plus two per extra scatter, with all of reel three gold. One to four Super Scatters in the trigger pay 50x, 500x, 5,000x or 100,000x. Pragmatic lists a 96.50% RTP.
